```artifact
Feature: Alarms
  As a user
  I want the GUI to compute battery ETA and trigger alarms
  So that I can be notified of low battery levels

  Scenario: GUI computes battery ETA from history of remaining battery amounts
    Given a history of remaining battery amounts
    When the GUI computes the battery ETA
    Then the battery ETA is calculated correctly

  Scenario: GUI is connected to a battery amount sensor
    Given a battery amount sensor is connected to the GUI
    When the GUI reads the battery amount
    Then the battery amount is displayed correctly

  Scenario: GUI computes "low battery" alarm when battery ETA is <30min
    Given a battery ETA of less than 30 minutes
    When the GUI computes the "low battery" alarm
    Then the "low battery" alarm is triggered with low priority

  Scenario: GUI computes "critically low battery" alarm when battery ETA is <10min
    Given a battery ETA of less than 10 minutes
    When the GUI computes the "critically low battery" alarm
    Then the "critically low battery" alarm is triggered with high priority

  Scenario: GUI reads hardware battery presence and chargeability sensors
    Given a battery presence sensor and a chargeability sensor
    When the GUI reads the sensor values
    Then the sensor values are displayed correctly

  Scenario: GUI triggers "battery failure" alarm when battery is absent, unavailable, or unchargeable
    Given a battery that is absent, unavailable, or unchargeable
    When the GUI computes the "battery failure" alarm
    Then the "battery failure" alarm is triggered

  Scenario Outline: GUI computes battery ETA with different history of remaining battery amounts
    Given a history of remaining battery amounts with <eta> minutes
    When the GUI computes the battery ETA
    Then the battery ETA is calculated correctly
    Examples:
      | eta |
      | 15  |
      | 30  |
      | 45  |
      | 60  |

  Scenario Outline: GUI triggers alarms with different battery ETAs
    Given a battery ETA of <eta> minutes
    When the GUI computes the alarms
    Then the alarms are triggered correctly
    Examples:
      | eta | alarm | priority |
      | 29  | low   | low      |
      | 10  | crit  | high     |
      | 0   | crit  | high     |
      | 31  | low   | low      |
```
